summary: Tested new developer project/unit management + consumer unit-detail flow. Backend: 6/6 new pytest tests pass in test_developer_management.py (create project as developer, create unit as developer, project appears in public list, unit appears in project detail with status=available, consumer 403 on both endpoints, unauthenticated 401/403, invalid project_id -> 404). Frontend Playwright end-to-end: Developer login shows Tambah Proyek + Tambah Unit buttons on /developer; created project 'UITest Proyek 18557' via dialog (pf-* fields + FLPP program) -> success + appears on landing page; created unit UITipe 36/72 Blok U/18557 with price 280,000,000 + all 3 images uploaded via uf-image-front/layout/siteplan -> success toast. Switched to consumer, opened project detail, clicked unit-detail-open row -> unit detail dialog shows title 'UITipe 36/72 — Blok U/18557', front photo visible, layout+siteplan images rendered, KPR simulator present. Clicked detail-book-btn -> booking dialog with 'Estimasi Down Payment' line updating as DP slider moves. Confirmed booking -> redirected to /portal -> payment dialog visible -> confirm-payment-btn works -> toast 'Pembayaran terverifikasi! SPR sedang diproses developer'. Zero console errors captured.
critical_code_review_comments: Base64 image data URLs are stored directly in MongoDB units documents (image_front/layout/siteplan). This inflates document size and GET /api/projects/{id} response. For production, offload to object storage (S3/GridFS) and store only URLs.
POST /api/developer/projects & /units have no size/mime validation on image data URLs — a large image could DoS the DB. Add max length check (e.g., 2 MB base64) and prefix validation.
UnitCreateInput has no uniqueness check on (project_id, block, number) — duplicate unit numbers can be created silently.
ProjectCreateInput does not validate `program` against allowed values (FLPP|KOMERSIAL) — accepts arbitrary string.
seed_data_creation: Created via UI: project 'UITest Proyek 18557' with unit UITipe 36/72 Blok U/18557 (price 280,000,000, images). Consumed by test booking (now Lunas + Draft SPR). Backend tests create TEST_ prefixed projects/units — not cleaned up.
